title: The Dining Philosophers
summary: Five philosophers sit around a table; each must pick up both neighbouring forks before eating, then put them down. A coordinator must make concurrent wantsToEat calls safe and avoid deadlock with the supplied pick, eat and put callbacks.
inputFormat: Philosopher index 0 to 4 and the callbacks for picking and putting forks and for eating; the fork-index mapping is not recorded.
outputFormat: No return value; callbacks are invoked in a valid order.
edgeRules: Fork-to-philosopher mapping is not recorded; starvation rule is not recorded.
factsMissing: Exact fork-index mapping (left fork index and right fork index for each philosopher)
questions: What is the exact fork-index mapping for each philosopher's left and right fork, and what is the wantsToEat signature?
